scoreUnitByField.vectorRank: 1-based rank in the vector leg after the standard filter; null when that leg did not find the node
scoreUnitByField.vectorScore: cosine similarity as Neo4j reports it, (1 + cosine) / 2 in [0, 1]; null when the vector leg did not find the node
